turns.assessment: The failure is confined to lightpath och145 in the S08-to-S23 direction. The S08 line interface raised EQPT_TX_FAIL exactly when the S23 receiver lost signal, OSNR, and receive power; the S23 channel monitor later confirmed loss of that channel. Stable amplifier telemetry and an unaffected reverse direction argue strongly against a span, amplifier, or bidirectional cable fault. This is a transmitter laser failure at S08.

proposals.rationale: The S08 transmitter raised EQPT_TX_FAIL at onset, while the far-end S23 interface and channel monitor lost the och145 optical signal. This exactly matches loss of the transmitted channel.
A broader line-card failure could also remove the transmitted channel, but valid unchanged receiver telemetry at this interface and the specific TX failure alarm favor an isolated laser failure.
